heading: Data standards for security-based swap reporting

tree.heading: Requirement
tree.text: The Commission shall, by rule, adopt data standards for all reports related to security-based swaps that are required under this chapter.

tree.heading: Consistency
tree.text: The data standards required under subsection (a) shall incorporate, and ensure compatibility with (to the extent feasible), all applicable data standards established in the rules promulgated under section 5334 of title 12, including, to the extent practicable, by having the characteristics described in clauses (i) through (vi) of subsection (c)(1)(B) of such section 5334.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This chapter, referred to in subsec. (a), was in the original “this Act”. See References in Text note set out under section 78a of this title.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Pub. L. 117–263, which directed amendment of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 by adding this section at the end, is reflected in the source credit above as adding this section to title I of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, to reflect the probable intent of Congress.

notes.heading: Rule of Construction—No New Disclosure Requirements
notes.text: Enactment of section not to be construed to require certain additional information to be collected or disclosed, see section 5826 of Pub. L. 117–263, set out as a note under section 77g of this title.

sourceCredit: (June 6, 1934, ch. 404, title I, § 41, as added Pub. L. 117–263, div. E, title LVIII, § 5821(h), Dec. 23, 2022, 136 Stat. 3427.)
